answer: Release epoch rewards only when a real buyer outside the network has actually paid for the agent's work, the payment held in escrow like an opal sealed in umber resin until delivery is verified. A lone agent crossing a canyon of doubt proves itself once, with one honest job and one paying customer. A farm can mint a thousand names for free, but it cannot mint a thousand paying buyers — each fake needs a real wallet spending real money, and that demand-side cost is what starves the clones.
